retail_vs_institutional_positioning.retail_positioning_summary: Across retail forums (Reddit r/autonomousvehicles, r/stocks, X FinTwit, and Stocktwits), Aurora Innovation has captured significant retail attention as the premier pure-play autonomous trucking company approaching public commercial deployment. Retail sentiment is +76% bullish, with traders focused on the upcoming 'Driver-Out' milestone on the Dallas-Houston lane. The derivatives market exhibits extraordinary call positioning: the Put/Call Open Interest ratio stands at just 0.14x, demonstrating that traders are overwhelmingly buying upside calls (such as $5.00, $6.00, and $7.00 strikes) rather than downside protective puts, despite high 30-day implied volatility (120.7% IV).
retail_vs_institutional_positioning.institutional_positioning_summary: Sell-side institutional equity research coverage is notably constructive, with 12 analysts covering AUR carrying an average price target of $12.13 (representing +151.1% upside from the $4.83 spot price, with high targets up to $18.00). Major investment banks view Aurora as the frontrunner in autonomous Class 8 commercial logistics, well ahead of competitors. Institutional buy-side desks are heavily focused on management's confirmation of the driver-out timeline and updates regarding the Continental manufacturing partnership. Long-only tech and logistics funds are accumulating positions with long-term horizons, while event-driven hedge funds are trading weekly straddles (pricing ±13.46% or ±$0.65/share) to capture the binary volatility around commercial dispatch announcements.
